text:
Boscán, you have been avenged, at my expense,

for my past harshness and my severity,

with which I used to reproach you for the tenderness

of your gentle heart.


Now I punish myself each day

for such wildness and such folly;

but it is a time when I might well blush

at my baseness and punish myself.


Know that, in my prime, and armed,

with my eyes open, I have surrendered

to the child you know, blind and naked.


No heart was ever consumed

by so beautiful a fire. If I am asked

about the rest, I am mute about the rest.

translation.title: Boscán, you have been avenged, at my expense...
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
